summary: The two failures from the host's run (wave answer, dance ring) did not reproduce: both pass alone and the full suite passes 38/38 on a rerun. They look like state-dependent flakes (creature busy/idle or not near the ring at suite start), not hard bugs.

failures.what: Flaky: in the host's suite run, a wave at Pinchy got no answer (Pinchy idle) and the dance ring never formed within 40 s
failures.steps: Run the full suite right after a work session; depends on what creatures are doing at that moment (fishing, sleeping, away from the ring)
failures.expected: A waved-at creature answers; critters gather in the ring when the test asks
failures.actual: Failed once in the host run (check: nobody answered the wave (Pinchy is idle); dancers never stood in the ring after 40 s). Both pass alone and in a full rerun (38/38).
